infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Hamro Safety uses your location during active emergencies and safety timer sessions to share your coordinates with trusted emergency contacts.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Hamro Safety uses background location only when you have activated SOS or a Safety Timer to ensure your safety circle can locate you in an emergency.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Hamro Safety to use your location during active emergencies.
